name: fernme-docs
description: Optional FERNme add-on: managed document evidence and photo memory.

interface.shortDescription: Optional document and photo tools for FERNme Memory.
interface.longDescription: Adds managed FERNmark document evidence and photo memory to the FERNme database used by the fernme-memory plugin. Install fernme-memory first.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use FERNme document tools only when I ask to import, read, or forget a document or photo.
